steps.title: Three small parts
steps.text: A menu that widens, a step bar and a progress ring. The menu has two links: a script animates the first with a tween, an animation computed step by step in code, and CSS animates the second with a transition. Both start 180 px wide.
steps.textZh: 一个会展开的导航、一个步骤条和一个环形进度。导航有两个链接：第一个由脚本用补间驱动动画（补间是在代码里一步步算出来的动画），第二个由 CSS 过渡驱动。两者起初都是 180 px 宽。

steps.title: A transition animates any change
steps.titleZh: 过渡会为任何变化播放动画
steps.text: `.modern a` has `transition: width 0.25s`, and its `:hover` and `:focus-visible` rules set `width: 260px`. This button sets the same 260 px as an inline style instead. The browser animates that change too: a transition reacts to the value changing, whatever changed it. Press it again to shrink the link.
steps.textZh: `.modern a` 设置了 `transition: width 0.25s`，它的 `:hover` 和 `:focus-visible` 规则把宽度设为 `width: 260px`。这个按钮改用行内样式设置同样的 260 px，浏览器照样播放动画：过渡响应的是值的变化，不管是什么改变了它。再按一次，链接就缩回去。

steps.title: The step bar
steps.text: Click **Next**: the highlight moves from **Read** to **Run**. The current step gets `aria-current="step"`, which tells assistive technology which step you are on, and the CSS styles that attribute.
steps.textZh: 点击**下一步**：高亮从**阅读**移到**运行**。当前这一步带有 `aria-current="step"`，告诉辅助技术你正处在哪一步，CSS 也根据这个属性设置样式。

steps.title: It stops at the last step
steps.text: The step stays between 1 and 3. This button clicks **Next** five more times: the bar stops on **Compare** and **Next** becomes disabled, so the extra clicks do nothing.
steps.textZh: 步骤始终在 1 到 3 之间。这个按钮再点五次**下一步**：步骤条停在**对比**，**下一步**被禁用，多出来的点击什么也不做。

steps.title: A ring from one gradient
steps.text: The slider writes its value to `--value`, a custom property (CSS variable) on the ring. The ring's background is `conic-gradient(#087b77 calc(var(--value) * 1%), #ddd 0)`: coloured up to that percentage of the circle and grey after it. A white circle on top turns the disc into a ring, and `aria-valuenow` reports the value. This button sets the slider to 70.
steps.textZh: 滑块把数值写到圆环的自定义属性（CSS 变量）`--value` 上。圆环的背景是 `conic-gradient(#087b77 calc(var(--value) * 1%), #ddd 0)`：圆周上这个百分比以内着色，之后是灰色。上面再叠一个白色圆，圆盘就变成了圆环；`aria-valuenow` 报告这个数值。这个按钮把滑块设为 70。

steps.title: Hover the menu by hand
steps.text: Hover over **JavaScript tween** and **CSS transition**, or move to them with the Tab key: both widen from 180 to 260 px and shrink back when you leave. The tween reads the current width on `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focus` and `blur`, and animates it over 250 ms with `requestAnimationFrame`, eased by `1 - (1 - t) ** 3`: fast at first, slow at the end. Leave half-way and it turns back smoothly from where it is.
steps.textZh: 把鼠标移到 **JavaScript 补间**和 **CSS 过渡**上，或者用 Tab 键移过去：两者都会从 180 px 展开到 260 px，离开后再缩回去。补间在 `mouseenter`、`mouseleave`、`focus` 和 `blur` 时读取当前宽度，用 `requestAnimationFrame` 在 250 毫秒内把它变过去，缓动公式是 `1 - (1 - t) ** 3`：开头快，结尾慢。中途离开，它会从当前的宽度平滑地折返。
